items.description:
A dimension key specifying the scope dimension for rate limiting.
Allowed values: "targetName", "toolName", "qualifiedModelId",
or context-path expressions: "$.context.iam.principal", "$.context.iam.sourceIdentity",
"$.context.jwt.<claim>" where <claim> is a JWT claim name (e.g., "$.context.jwt.sub").
Validated server-side to enforce allowed prefixes and patterns.
items.markdownDescription:
A dimension key specifying the scope dimension for rate limiting.
Allowed values: "targetName", "toolName", "qualifiedModelId",
or context-path expressions: "$.context.iam.principal", "$.context.iam.sourceIdentity",
"$.context.jwt.<claim>" where <claim> is a JWT claim name (e.g., "$.context.jwt.sub").
Validated server-side to enforce allowed prefixes and patterns.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 1  
Maximum Length: 80  
Pattern: ^(targetName|toolName|qualifiedModelId|\$\.context\.iam\.principal|\$\.context\.iam\.sourceIdentity|\$\.context\.jwt\.[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9_])$  
Update requires: No interruption
